tagline: Global leader in heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration solutions for residential and commercial markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Master indicator of consolidated business performance, reflecting demand for HVACR solutions and the impact of recent acquisitions (Duro Dyne and Supco in Q4 2025)

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.description: Total company revenue. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data over the last 8 years.
kpis.signal: Decrease of 3% compared to 2024, offset by favorable price and mix of 9%

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross profit as a percentage of net sales
kpis.signal: Margin expansion of 10 basis points driven by favorable price and mix of 290 bps, partially offset by higher product costs (160 bps) and freight (120 bps)

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of net sales
kpis.signal: Operating margin improved 50 basis points despite 3% revenue decline, demonstrating operational leverage and SG&A efficiency (down 60 bps to 13.1%)

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before interest and taxes
kpis.signal: Operating income essentially flat year-over-year at $1,042M vs $1,040M in 2024, demonstrating resilience despite revenue headwinds

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to common shareholders
kpis.signal: Net income decreased slightly to $806M from $811M in 2024, reflecting slight decline from operational performance

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €4.08B in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €1.77B in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €0.03B in the latest year

kpis.name: DPS
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $1.3 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Cap Return
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.173B in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 21.5% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.signal: Revenue decline of 3% driven by lower volumes (-13%), partially offset by favorable price and mix (+9%) and Q4 acquisitions (+1%)

kpis.name: Home Comfort Solutions Revenue
kpis.explanation: Net sales from Home Comfort Solutions segment
kpis.description: Revenue from the Home Comfort Solutions segment
kpis.signal: Segment experienced 7% sales decline and $32M decrease in segment profit primarily from lower sales volumes

kpis.name: Building Climate Solutions Revenue
kpis.explanation: Net sales from Building Climate Solutions segment
kpis.description: Revenue from the Building Climate Solutions segment
kpis.signal: Segment grew 5% in net sales with $33M increase in segment profit driven by favorable price and mix; includes Duro Dyne acquisition in Q4

risks.title: Competition in the HVACR business
risks.score_rationale: Competition is mentioned first in the risk factors, indicating primary management concern. The HVACR industry is capital and scale-intensive, directly impacting pricing power and market share.

risks.title: Volatility of raw material prices and significant supply interruptions
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly detailed in MD&A with specific commodities mentioned (steel, aluminum, copper). 2025 financials show 160 bps margin impact from higher product costs and 120 bps from freight, demonstrating materiality.

risks.title: Dependence on customer demand and general economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: MD&A emphasizes that demand is influenced by new construction, interest rates, financing availability, and consumer confidence. 13% volume decline in 2025 demonstrates cyclical vulnerability.

risks.title: Product liability, warranty claims, recalls, and litigation risks
risks.score_rationale: MD&A references $10.9M in environmental liabilities and special litigation charges for 2025, including asbestos-related litigation and facility remediation costs.

risks.title: Cyber attacks and information systems disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified in forward-looking statements as cyber attack risk. Standard risk for technology-dependent industrial manufacturers with distribution networks.

risks.title: Ability to attract, motivate, develop and retain employees
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in risk factors. MD&A notes 2025 benefited from 'reduced incentive compensation,' indicating labor market management challenges.

risks.title: Changes in environmental, climate, and tax legislation
risks.score_rationale: One Big Beautiful Bill Act enacted July 4, 2025, with future fiscal impacts. Climate regulations increasingly impact HVAC efficiency standards and product requirements.

risks.title: Decline in new construction activity
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited as risk factor. MD&A indicates replacement business is 'substantial portion' but new construction highly cyclical and interest-rate sensitive.

risks.title: Impact of weather on business
risks.score_rationale: MD&A notes demand is 'seasonal and significantly impacted by weather.' Warmer/cooler than normal temperatures directly affect replacement product demand.

risks.title: Trade tariffs and international operations risks
risks.score_rationale: Listed as forward-looking risk. New or increased trade tariffs could affect manufacturing costs and international competitiveness.

ai_positioning.summary: Artificial intelligence is mentioned as a forward-looking risk factor in the 10-K, indicating management awareness but limited integration or strategic positioning. The company lists AI technologies among factors that could affect future performance but does not elaborate on specific applications or opportunities.
evidence: Listed in risk factors as 'artificial intelligence technologies' among factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from forward-looking statements
